verses.text: Di Canaanite, di king of Arad, wey dwell for di South, hear say Israel dey come by di way of Atharim. E fight against Israel, and take some of dem captive.
Israel vow one vow to di Lord, and talk, “If you go indeed deliver dis people into my hand, I go utterly destroy dem cities.”
Di Lord listen to di voice of Israel, and deliver up di Canaanites. Dem utterly destroy dem and dem cities. Di name of di place dem call Hormah.
Dem journey from Mount Hor by di way to di Red Sea, to go around di land of Edom. Di soul of di people dey very discouraged because of di way.
Di people speak against God, and against Moses, “Why una don bring us up out of Egypt to die for di wilderness? Because dere no dey bread, and dere no dey water, and our soul loathe dis light bread.”
Di Lord send fiery serpents among di people, and dem bite di people. Many people of Israel die.
Di people come to Moses, and talk, “We don sin, because we don speak against di Lord, and against you. Pray to di Lord, make e take away di serpents from us.” Moses pray for di people.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Make you one fiery serpent, and set am on one pole. E go be say everyone wey dey bitten, when e look at am, go live.”
Moses make one serpent of bronze, and set am on di pole. E come be say, if one serpent don bite any man, when e look to di serpent of bronze, e live.
Di pikin dem of Israel journey, and encamp for Oboth.
Dem journey from Oboth, and encamp for Iye Abarim, for di wilderness wey dey before Moab, toward di sunrise.
From dere dem journey, and encamp for di valley of Zered.
From dere dem journey, and encamp on di other side of di Arnon, wey dey di wilderness wey come out of di border of di Amorites, because di Arnon na di border of Moab, between Moab and di Amorites.
Na why e dey talk for di book of di Wars of di Lord, “Waheb for Suphah, and di valleys of di Arnon,
and di slope of di valleys wey go down to di dwelling of Ar, and lean on di border of Moab.”
From dere dem journey to Beer. Dat na di well wey di Lord talk to Moses about, “Gather di people together, and I go give dem water.”
Israel sing dis song: “Spring up, well! Sing to am,
di well, wey di princes dig, wey di nobles of di people sink, with di sceptre, and with dem staffs.” From di wilderness dem go to Mattanah.
From Mattanah to Nahaliel. From Nahaliel to Bamoth.
From Bamoth to di valley wey dey di field of Moab, to di top of Pisgah, wey look down on di desert.
Israel send messengers to Sihon king of di Amorites, talk,
“Make I pass through your land. We no go turn aside into field or into vineyard. We no go drink of di water of di wells. We go go by di king highway, until we don pass your border.”
Sihon no allow Israel to pass through im border, but Sihon gather all im people together, and go out against Israel into di wilderness, and come to Jahaz, and fight against Israel.
Israel strike am with di edge of di sword, and possess im land from di Arnon to di Jabbok, even to di pikin dem of Ammon, because di border of di pikin dem of Ammon dey strong.
Israel take all dem cities. Israel dwell for all di cities of di Amorites, for Heshbon, and for all im towns.
Because Heshbon na di city of Sihon di king of di Amorites, wey don fight against di former king of Moab, and take all im land out of im hand, even to di Arnon.
Na why dem wey speak for proverbs talk, “Come to Heshbon. Make di city of Sihon dey built and established.
Because fire don go out of Heshbon, one flame from di city of Sihon. E don consume Ar of Moab, di lords of di high places of di Arnon.
Woe to you, Moab! You perish, people of Chemosh! E don give im pikin man dem as fugitives, and im pikin woman dem into captivity, to Sihon king of di Amorites.
We don shoot dem. Heshbon don perish even to Dibon. We don lay waste even to Nophah, wey reach to Medeba.”
So Israel dwell for di land of di Amorites.
Moses send to spy out Jazer, and dem take im towns, and drive out di Amorites wey dey dere.
Dem turn and go up by di way of Bashan. Og di king of Bashan go out against dem, e and all im people, to battle for Edrei.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “No fear am, because I don deliver am into your hand, with all im people, and im land. You go do to am as you do to Sihon king of di Amorites, wey dwell for Heshbon.”
So dem strike am, and im pikin man dem, and all im people, until none remain to am alive. Dem possess im land.
Di pikin dem of Israel journey, and encamp for di plains of Moab beyond di Jordan at Jericho.
Balak di pikin of Zippor see all wey Israel don do to di Amorites.
Moab fear di people greatly, because dem plenty. Moab dey distressed because of di pikin dem of Israel.
Moab talk to di elders of Midian, “Now dis multitude go lick up all wey dey round us, as di ox lick up di grass of di field.” Balak di pikin of Zippor na king of Moab for dat time.

E send messengers to Balaam di pikin of Beor, to Pethor, wey dey by di River, to di land of di pikin dem of im people, to call am, talk, “Look, one people don come out from Egypt. Look, dem cover di surface of di earth, and dem dey dwell opposite me.

Come now therefore, curse dis people for me, because dem too mighty for me. Maybe I go prevail, so that we go strike dem, and drive dem out of di land, because I know say e wey you bless dey blessed, and e wey you curse dey cursed.”
Di elders of Moab and di elders of Midian depart with di fee for divination for dem hand. Dem come to Balaam, and speak to am di words of Balak.
E talk to dem, “Lodge here dis night, and I go bring you word again, as di Lord go speak to me.” Di princes of Moab stay with Balaam.
God come to Balaam, and talk, “Who be dem men wey dey with you?”
Balaam talk to God, “Balak di pikin of Zippor, king of Moab, don send to me, talk,
‘Look, di people wey don come out of Egypt cover di surface of di earth. Come now, curse dem for me. Maybe I go dey able to fight against dem, and drive dem out.’”
God talk to Balaam, “You no go go with dem. You no go curse di people, because dem dey blessed.”
Balaam rise up for morning, and talk to di princes of Balak, “Go to your land, because di Lord refuse to give me permission to go with una.”
Di princes of Moab rise up, and dem go to Balak, and talk, “Balaam refuse to come with us.”
Balak send again princes, more, and more honourable pass dem.
Dem come to Balaam, and talk to am, “Balak di pikin of Zippor talk so: ‘Make nothing hinder you from coming to me,
because I go promote you to very great honour, and I go do whatever you talk to me. Come therefore, curse dis people for me.’”
Balaam answer di servants of Balak, “If Balak go give me im house full of silver and gold, I no fit go beyond di word of di Lord my God, to do less or more.
Now therefore, una wait here too dis night, so that I go know wetin more di Lord go speak to me.”
God come to Balaam for night, and talk to am, “If di men don come to call you, rise up, go with dem. But only di word wey I speak to you, dat una go do.”
Balaam rise up for morning, saddle im donkey, and go with di princes of Moab.
God dey angry because e go. Di angel of di Lord stand for di way as one adversary against am. Now e dey ride on im donkey, and im two servants dey with am.
Di donkey see di angel of di Lord standing for di way, with im sword drawn for im hand. Di donkey turn aside out of di way, and go into di field. Balaam strike di donkey, to turn am into di way.
Di angel of di Lord stand for one narrow path between di vineyards, wey get one wall on dis side, and one wall on dat side.
Di donkey see di angel of di Lord, and e press imself to di wall, and crush Balaam foot against di wall. E strike am again.
Di angel of di Lord go further, and stand for one narrow place, wia no way dey to turn either to di right hand or to di left.
Di donkey see di angel of di Lord, and lie down under Balaam. Balaam anger dey kindled, and e strike di donkey with im staff.
Di Lord open di mouth of di donkey, and e talk to Balaam, “Wetin I don do to you, say you don strike me dem three times?”
Balaam talk to di donkey, “Because you don mock me. If I get one sword for my hand, I for don kill you now.”
Di donkey talk to Balaam, “I no be your donkey, wey you don ride all your life long to dis day? I dey ever dey wont to do so to you?” E talk, “No.”
Di Lord open di eyes of Balaam, and e see di angel of di Lord standing for di way, with im sword drawn for im hand. E bow im head, and fall on im face.
Di angel of di Lord talk to am, “Why you don strike your donkey dem three times? Look, I don come out as one adversary, because your way dey perverse before me.
Di donkey see me, and turn aside before me dem three times. If e no turn aside from me, surely now I for don kill you, and save am alive.”
Balaam talk to di angel of di Lord, “I don sin, because I no know say you stand for di way against me. Now therefore, if e dey evil for your sight, I go go back again.”
Di angel of di Lord talk to Balaam, “Go with di men, but only di word wey I go speak to you, dat you go speak.” So Balaam go with di princes of Balak.
When Balak hear say Balaam dey come, e go out to meet am at di city of Moab, wey dey di border of di Arnon, wey dey di utmost part of di border.
Balak talk to Balaam, “I no send urgently to you to call you? Why you no come to me? I no dey really able to promote you to honour?”
Balaam talk to Balak, “Look, I don come to you. Now I get any power at all to speak anything? Di word wey God put for my mouth, dat I go speak.”
Balaam go with Balak, and dem come to Kiriath Huzoth.
Balak sacrifice oxen and sheep, and send to Balaam, and to di princes wey dey with am.
E come be say for morning, Balak take Balaam, and bring am up into di high places of Baal, and from dere e see di utmost part of di people.
Balaam talk to Balak, “Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bulls and seven rams.”
Balak do as Balaam talk. Balak and Balaam offer on every altar one bull and one ram.
Balaam talk to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I go go. Maybe di Lord go come to meet me. Wetin e show me, I go tell you.” E go to one bare height.
God meet Balaam, and e talk to am, “I don prepare seven altars, and I don offer on every altar one bull and one ram.”
Di Lord put one word for Balaam mouth, and talk, “Return to Balak, and na so you go speak.”
E return to am, and look, e stand by im burnt offering, e and all di princes of Moab.
Balaam take up im parable, and talk, “Balak, di king of Moab, don bring me from Aram, from di mountains of di east: ‘Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.’
How I go curse wey God no curse? How I go defy wey di Lord no defy?
Because from di top of di rocks I see am, from di hills I behold am. Look, na people wey dey dwell alone, and no go dey reckoned among di nations.
Who fit count di dust of Jacob, or number di fourth part of Israel? Make I die di death of di righteous, and make my last end dey like im!”
Balak talk to Balaam, “Wetin you don do to me? I take you to curse my enemies, and look, you don bless dem altogether.”
E answer, “I no suppose take care to speak wetin di Lord put for my mouth?”
Balak talk to am, “Come with me to another place, from wia you fit see dem. You go see only di utmost part of dem, and no go see dem all. Curse dem for me from dere.”
E take am into di field of Zophim, to di top of Pisgah, and build seven altars, and offer one bull and one ram on every altar.
E talk to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet di Lord over dere.”
Di Lord meet Balaam, and put one word for im mouth, and talk, “Return to Balak, and na so you go speak.”
E come to am, and look, e stand by im burnt offering, and di princes of Moab with am. Balak talk to am, “Wetin di Lord don speak?”
E take up im parable, and talk, “Rise up, Balak, and hear. Listen to me, you pikin of Zippor.
God no be man, say e go lie, neither di pikin of man, say e go repent. E don talk, and e no go do am? Or e don speak, and e no go make am good?
Look, I don receive commandment to bless. E don bless, and I no fit reverse am.
E no see iniquity for Jacob, neither e don see perverseness for Israel. Di Lord im God dey with am. Di shout of one king dey among dem.
God bring dem out of Egypt. E get di strength of di wild ox.
Surely dere dey no enchantment against Jacob, neither dey any divination against Israel. Now e go dey talk of Jacob and of Israel, ‘Look wetin God don do!’
Look, di people rise up like one lioness, and as one lion e lift imself up. E no go lie down until e eat of di prey, and drink di blood of di slain.”
Balak talk to Balaam, “Neither curse dem at all, nor bless dem at all.”
But Balaam answer Balak, “I no tell you, say ‘All wey di Lord speak, dat I must do’?”
Balak talk to Balaam, “Come now, I go take you to another place. Maybe e go dey good for God eyes say you curse dem for me from dere.”
Balak take Balaam to di top of Peor, wey look down on di desert.
Balaam talk to Balak, “Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bulls and seven rams.”
Balak do as Balaam talk, and offer one bull and one ram on every altar.
When Balaam see say e dey good for di Lord eyes to bless Israel, e no go, as for other times, to seek enchantments, but e set im face toward di wilderness.
Balaam lift up im eyes, and see Israel dwelling according to dem tribes. Di Spirit of God come on am.
E take up im parable, and talk, “Balaam di pikin of Beor talk, di man wey im eyes dey open talk,
e talk, wey hear di words of God, wey see di vision of di Almighty, falling down, and having im eyes open:
How goodly na your tents, Jacob, your dwellings, Israel!
As valleys dem dey spread forth, as gardens by di riverside, as aloes wey di Lord don plant, as cedar trees beside di waters.
Water go flow from im buckets, and im seed go dey for many waters. Im king go dey higher pass Agag, and im kingdom go dey exalted.
God bring am out of Egypt. E get di strength of di wild ox. E go eat up di nations im adversaries, and go break dem bones in pieces, and pierce dem through with im arrows.
E crouch, e lie down as one lion, and as one lioness. Who go rouse am up? Blessed be everyone wey bless you, and cursed be everyone wey curse you.”
Balak anger dey kindled against Balaam, and e strike im hands together. Balak talk to Balaam, “I call you to curse my enemies, and look, you don altogether bless dem three times.
Therefore now flee to your place. I think to promote you to great honour, but look, di Lord don keep you back from honour.”
Balaam talk to Balak, “I no speak also to your messengers wey you send to me, talk,
‘If Balak go give me im house full of silver and gold, I no fit go beyond di word of di Lord, to do either good or bad of my own mind. Wetin di Lord speak, dat I go speak’?
Now look, I dey go to my people. Come, and I go advise you wetin dis people go do to your people for di latter days.”
E take up im parable, and talk, “Balaam di pikin of Beor talk, di man wey im eyes dey open talk,
e talk, wey hear di words of God, and know di knowledge of di Most High, wey see di vision of di Almighty, falling down, and having im eyes open:
I see am, but no now. I behold am, but no near. One star go come out of Jacob. One sceptre go rise out of Israel, and go strike through di corners of Moab, and break down all di pikin dem of Sheth.
Edom go be one possession. Seir, im enemies, go also be one possession, while Israel do valiantly.
Out of Jacob one go have dominion, and go destroy di remnant from di city.”
E look on Amalek, and take up im parable, and talk, “Amalek na di first of di nations, but im latter end go be destruction.”
E look on di Kenites, and take up im parable, and talk, “Your dwelling place dey strong. Your nest dey set for di rock.
Nevertheless Kain go be wasted, until Asshur carry you away captive.”
E take up im parable, and talk, “Alas, who go live when God do dis?
But ships go come from di coast of Kittim, and dem go afflict Asshur, and afflict Eber. E too go come to destruction.”
Balaam rise up, and go and return to im place. Balak too go im way.
Israel dwell for Shittim, and di people begin to play di prostitute with di pikin woman dem of Moab.
Dem call di people to di sacrifices of dem gods. Di people eat, and bow down to dem gods.
Israel join imself to Baal Peor, and di anger of di Lord dey kindled against Israel.
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Take all di chiefs of di people, and hang dem up to di Lord before di sun, so that di fierce anger of di Lord go turn away from Israel.”
Moses talk to di judges of Israel, “Everyone of una kill im men wey don join demself to Baal Peor.”

Look, one of di pikin dem of Israel come and bring to im brothers one Midianite woman, for di sight of Moses, and for di sight of all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel, while dem dey weeping for di door of di Tent of Meeting.
When Phinehas, di pikin of Eleazar, di pikin of Aaron di priest, see am, e rise up from among di congregation, and take one spear for im hand.
E go after di man of Israel into di tent, and thrust both of dem through, di man of Israel, and di woman through im body. So di plague dey stopped from di pikin dem of Israel.
Dem wey die by di plague na 24,000.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,

“Phinehas, di pikin of Eleazar, di pikin of Aaron di priest, don turn my wrath away from di pikin dem of Israel, in dat e dey zealous with my zeal among dem, so that I no consume di pikin dem of Israel for my zeal.
Therefore talk, ‘Look, I give to am my covenant of peace.
E go be to am, and to im seed after am, di covenant of one perpetual priesthood, because e dey zealous for im God, and make atonement for di pikin dem of Israel.’”
Now di name of di man of Israel wey dem strike, wey dem strike with di Midianite woman, na Zimri, di pikin of Salu, one prince of one papa house among di Simeonites.
Di name of di Midianite woman wey dem strike na Cozbi, di pikin woman of Zur. E na head of one tribe of one papa house for Midian.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Harass di Midianites, and strike dem,

because dem harass una with dem wiles, wherein dem don deceive una for di matter of Peor, and for di matter of Cozbi, di pikin woman of di prince of Midian, dem sister, wey dem strike for di day of di plague for di matter of Peor.”
After di plague, di Lord speak to Moses and to Eleazar di pikin of Aaron di priest, talk,
“Take di census of all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel, from 20 years old and above, by dem papa houses, all wey fit go to war for Israel.”
Moses and Eleazar di priest speak with dem for di plains of Moab by di Jordan at Jericho, talk,
“Take di census of di people, from 20 years old and above,” as di Lord command Moses and di pikin dem of Israel, wey come out of di land of Egypt.
Reuben, di firstborn of Israel. Di pikin dem of Reuben: of Hanoch, di family of di Hanochites. Of Pallu, di family of di Palluites.
Of Hezron, di family of di Hezronites. Of Carmi, di family of di Carmites.
Dem na di families of di Reubenites. Dem wey dem number of dem na 43,730.
Di pikin dem of Pallu: Eliab.

Di pikin dem of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. Dis na dat Dathan and Abiram, wey dem call from di congregation, wey strive against Moses and against Aaron for di company of Korah, when dem strive against di Lord,
and di earth open im mouth, and swallow dem up together with Korah, when dat company die, when di fire devour 250 men, and dem become one sign.
Notwithstanding di pikin dem of Korah no die.
Di pikin dem of Simeon after dem families: of Nemuel, di family of di Nemuelites. Of Jamin, di family of di Jaminites. Of Jachin, di family of di Jachinites.
Of Zerah, di family of di Zerahites. Of Shaul, di family of di Shaulites.
Dem na di families of di Simeonites, 22,200.
Di pikin dem of Gad after dem families: of Zephon, di family of di Zephonites. Of Haggi, di family of di Haggites. Of Shuni, di family of di Shunites.
Of Ozni, di family of di Oznites. Of Eri, di family of di Erites.
Of Arod, di family of di Arodites. Of Areli, di family of di Arelites.
Dem na di families of di pikin dem of Gad according to dem number, 40,500.
Di pikin dem of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan die for di land of Canaan.
Di pikin dem of Judah after dem families: of Shelah, di family of di Shelanites. Of Perez, di family of di Perezites. Of Zerah, di family of di Zerahites.
Di pikin dem of Perez: of Hezron, di family of di Hezronites. Of Hamul, di family of di Hamulites.
Dem na di families of Judah according to dem number, 76,500.
Di pikin dem of Issachar after dem families: of Tola, di family of di Tolaites. Of Puvah, di family of di Punites.
Of Jashub, di family of di Jashubites. Of Shimron, di family of di Shimronites.
Dem na di families of Issachar according to dem number, 64,300.
Di pikin dem of Zebulun after dem families: of Sered, di family of di Seredites. Of Elon, di family of di Elonites. Of Jahleel, di family of di Jahleelites.
Dem na di families of di Zebulunites according to dem number, 60,500.
Di pikin dem of Joseph after dem families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
Di pikin dem of Manasseh: of Machir, di family of di Machirites. Machir born Gilead. Of Gilead, di family of di Gileadites.
Dem na di pikin dem of Gilead: of Iezer, di family of di Iezerites. Of Helek, di family of di Helekites.
Of Asriel, di family of di Asrielites. Of Shechem, di family of di Shechemites.
Of Shemida, di family of di Shemidaites. Of Hepher, di family of di Hepherites.
Zelophehad di pikin of Hepher get no pikin man dem, but pikin woman dem. Di names of di pikin woman dem of Zelophehad na Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
Dem na di families of Manasseh. Dem wey dem number of dem na 52,700.
Dem na di pikin dem of Ephraim after dem families: of Shuthelah, di family of di Shuthelahites. Of Becher, di family of di Becherites. Of Tahan, di family of di Tahanites.
Dem na di pikin dem of Shuthelah: of Eran, di family of di Eranites.
Dem na di families of di pikin dem of Ephraim according to dem number, 32,500. Dem na di pikin dem of Joseph after dem families.
Di pikin dem of Benjamin after dem families: of Bela, di family of di Belaites. Of Ashbel, di family of di Ashbelites. Of Ahiram, di family of di Ahiramites.
Of Shephupham, di family of di Shuphamites. Of Hupham, di family of di Huphamites.
Di pikin dem of Bela: Ard and Naaman. Of Ard, di family of di Ardites. Of Naaman, di family of di Naamites.
Dem na di pikin dem of Benjamin after dem families. Dem wey dem number of dem na 45,600.
Dem na di pikin dem of Dan after dem families: of Shuham, di family of di Shuhamites. Dem na di families of Dan after dem families.
All di families of di Shuhamites, according to dem number, na 64,400.
Di pikin dem of Asher after dem families: of Imnah, di family of di Imnites. Of Ishvi, di family of di Ishvites. Of Beriah, di family of di Beriites.
Of di pikin dem of Beriah: of Heber, di family of di Heberites. Of Malchiel, di family of di Malchielites.
Di name of di pikin woman of Asher na Serah.
Dem na di families of di pikin dem of Asher according to dem number, 53,400.
Di pikin dem of Naphtali after dem families: of Jahzeel, di family of di Jahzeelites. Of Guni, di family of di Gunites.
Of Jezer, di family of di Jezerites. Of Shillem, di family of di Shillemites.
Dem na di families of Naphtali according to dem families. Dem wey dem number of dem na 45,400.
Dem na dem wey dem number of di pikin dem of Israel, 601,730.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“To dem di land go dey divided for inheritance according to di number of names.
To di many you go give di more inheritance, and to di few you go give di less inheritance. To everyone, according to dem wey dem number of am, e go dey given im inheritance.
Notwithstanding di land go dey divided by lot. According to di names of di tribes of dem papa dem dem go inherit.
According to di lot e go dey divided between di many and di few.”
Dem na dem wey dem number of di Levites after dem families: of Gershon, di family of di Gershonites. Of Kohath, di family of di Kohathites. Of Merari, di family of di Merarites.
Dem na di families of Levi: di family of di Libnites, di family of di Hebronites, di family of di Mahlites, di family of di Mushites, di family of di Korahites. Kohath born Amram.
Di name of Amram wife na Jochebed, di pikin woman of Levi, wey dem born to Levi for Egypt. E born to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam dem sister.
To Aaron dem born Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Nadab and Abihu die, when dem offer strange fire before di Lord.

Dem wey dem number of dem na 23,000, every male from one month old and above, because dem no dey numbered among di pikin dem of Israel, because dem no give dem any inheritance among di pikin dem of Israel.
Dem na dem wey Moses and Eleazar di priest number, wey number di pikin dem of Israel for di plains of Moab by di Jordan at Jericho.
But among dem no man dey of dem wey Moses and Aaron di priest number, wey number di pikin dem of Israel for di wilderness of Sinai.
Because di Lord talk of dem, “Dem go surely die for di wilderness.” None of dem remain, except Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh, and Joshua di pikin of Nun.

Di pikin woman dem of Zelophehad, di pikin of Hepher, di pikin of Gilead, di pikin of Machir, di pikin of Manasseh, of di families of Manasseh di pikin of Joseph, come near. Dem names na Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
Dem stand before Moses, and before Eleazar di priest, and before di princes and all di congregation, by di door of di Tent of Meeting, talk,
“Our papa die for di wilderness, and e no dey among di company of dem wey gather demself together against di Lord for di company of Korah, but e die for im own sin. E get no pikin man dem.
Why di name of our papa go dey taken away from among im family, because e get no pikin man? Give us one possession among di brothers of our papa.”
Moses bring dem cause before di Lord.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Di pikin woman dem of Zelophehad speak right. You go surely give dem one possession of inheritance among dem papa brothers, and you go cause di inheritance of dem papa to pass to dem.
You go speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘If one man die, and get no pikin man, una go cause im inheritance to pass to im pikin woman.
If e get no pikin woman, una go give im inheritance to im brothers.
If e get no brothers, una go give im inheritance to im papa brothers.

If im papa get no brothers, una go give im inheritance to im relative wey dey nearest to am of im family, and e go possess am. E go be to di pikin dem of Israel one statute of judgment, as di Lord command Moses.’”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Go up into dis mountain of Abarim, and see di land wey I don give to di pikin dem of Israel.
When you don see am, you too go dey gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother dey gathered,

because una rebel against my word for di wilderness of Zin, for di strife of di congregation, to make me holy for di waters before dem eyes.” Dem na di waters of Meribah of Kadesh for di wilderness of Zin.
Moses speak to di Lord, talk,
“Make di Lord, di God of di spirits of all flesh, appoint one man over di congregation,
wey go go out before dem, and wey go come in before dem, and wey go lead dem out, and wey go bring dem in, so that di congregation of di Lord no go be like sheep wey no get shepherd.”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Take Joshua di pikin of Nun, one man in whom di Spirit dey, and lay your hand on am.
Set am before Eleazar di priest, and before all di congregation, and commission am for dem sight.
You go put some of your honour on am, so that all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel go obey.

E go stand before Eleazar di priest, wey go enquire for am by di judgment of di Urim before di Lord. At im word dem go go out, and at im word dem go come in, both e, and all di pikin dem of Israel with am, even all di congregation.”
Moses do as di Lord command am. E take Joshua, and set am before Eleazar di priest, and before all di congregation.
E lay im hands on am, and commission am, as di Lord speak by di hand of Moses.
